title: Veetla Visheshanga
desc: A widower helps a woman by admitting her to the hospital. However, complications arise when the doctor convinces her that he is her husband.

title: Ulle Veliye
desc: A corrupt officer's life changes when a woman's sacrifice saves him from the authorities.

title: Krodham
desc: A young businessman is happily married and loves his wife. However, his life turns upside down when his wife gets raped and killed by strangers, and he sets out to seek revenge.

title: Maanasthan
desc: Deiva, a successful farmer and obedient son, is stunned when his father learns he's not his biological child. Betrayed, his father asks him to leave, leading Deiva on a journey of self-discovery.
